notes.title: 14 hours on the demo. Who are you?
notes.content:
[p]Some people finish the demo in 30 minutes.
This person spent 14 hours on it.[/p][p]Was it skill? Determination?
…Or just an Alt+Tab lost in the voids of Steam?[/p][p]We’ll probably never know.[/p][p]But thank you, unknown player. ❤️
And thanks also to everyone who already took the time to try the demo. 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]For those who haven’t yet, the demo recently received a [b]full visual overhaul[/b]:
same environments, but with a big graphical upgrade and a reworked atmosphere.[/p][p]The Steam Next Fest is coming soon, and I hope more brave players will give it a shot.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 The demo is free.
One level. No checkpoints. Pure die & retry.[/p][p]💬 If you’ve played it, feel free to leave a short review, it really helps a lot.[/p][p][/p][p]🛠️ [b]PS:[/b] I'm currently working on the game's final level.
There’s still more work to do,  polishing, tweaking, balancing…
But yes: full release is planned for [b]2026[/b].[/p][p]Good luck.
You’ll need it.[/p]

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

I'm excited to share the latest update for the Atrion Project demo! This patch includes significant improvements, new features, and fixes inspired by your feedback. A special thank you to the amazing members of the Discord community who’ve helped track down bugs and provided invaluable suggestions. Your support means the world to me!

Patch Notes 

⚔️ Gameplay Enhancements
Added a teleportation system to quickly return to the start of a level.
The wake-up cutscene is now skippable for a smoother start.
Improved the hit feedback to make combat feel more satisfying.
Platforms now properly stop when the game is paused.
Introduced controller vibration for a more immersive experience.

🎮 Balance & Difficulty
Added a boss health bar for better fight clarity.
Adjusted tutorial difficulty in Easy Mode: the Firefly Queen now deals less damage.
Added a difficulty explanation pop-up in the main menu for better understanding.
Continued work on the power system—more features are on the way!

🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug causing rapid health loss when HP is low.
Resolved an issue where players could pass through walls during a pause.
Fixed a problem with the ghoul enemy running on spikes.

✨ Visual and Sound Upgrades
New sword impact effects when hitting enemies.
Enhanced visual effects for basic attacks and the super blaster.
Added an impact sound for successful hits.
Introduced glow effects to enhance visuals.

🖥️ HUD & Interface
Improved dialogue boxes for better readability.
Upgraded the Atrion HUD for a cleaner look.
Enhanced visuals for the main menu.

🎞️ Animations
Atrion now has a special idle animation when waiting—keep an eye out!
Improved animations for level selection, bestiary reading, and idle sequences.

I hope you enjoy this update and the improvements it brings to the Atrion Project demo.

Your feedback is essential, so feel free to share more thoughts and suggestions in the community forums or on Discord.

Thank you for being part of this adventure!
Cheers !

notes.title: Atrion Project Demo
notes.content:
[b][b]Hello everyone, 👋[/b]
I hope those of you who have already played the demo had a great experience! 
Based on your feedback, here is the list of things that have been fixed:[/b]

[b]Patch of 07/13/2024[/b]
* Rate of fire increased by 25% 🔥
* Projectile speed increased by 6% 💨
* Boss eye hitbox increased by 15% 👁️
* Fixed a critical bug that prevented Atrion from dying 🐞
* Corrected spelling errors ✔️

[b]Patch of 07/16/2024[/b]
* Improved movement: it is now possible to interrupt attacks at any time 🏃‍♂️
* Fixed the infinite jumps bug 🚫🔄

[b]Patch of 07/20/2024[/b]
* Pause menu controls changed to avoid unintentionally leaving the game 🛑
* Sliding gates added to the hub 🚪
* It is now possible to run in the portal area 🏃
* Added a sound effect when the boss is hit 🎯
* Fixed a sound bug 🐞

[b]🚨‼️ Please uninstall and reinstall the game to apply patches. 📢[/b]


[b]I'm continuing to make progress on the development of the game and I really appreciate your feedback, which helps me to make it better!

Thank you for your support, I hope you enjoy these updates. 
Have a great summer vacation! 🌞 
Happy gaming! 🎮[/b]
